## Complete Repository Map: `tutors-sdk/tutors-apps`

### Overview

This is a monorepo for the **Tutors** open learning platform's **generator** tools. It transforms folders of learning content (Markdown, PDFs, images, YAML config) into consumable course formats -- either dynamic JSON for the Tutors Reader web app, or static HTML sites. The default branch is `development`.

---

### 1. Technology Stack

- **Runtime:** Deno (primary), Node.js (for `tutors-publish-npm` backward compatibility)
- **Language:** TypeScript throughout
- **Package Manager:** npm workspaces at root level; Deno workspaces under `cli/`
- **Deno registry:** Packages published to [JSR](https://jsr.io/) (the Deno package registry)
- **Templating:** [Vento](https://jsr.io/@vento/vento) (`.vto` templates) for static HTML generation
- **Markdown processing:** `markdown-it` with plugins (KaTeX, anchors, ToC, emoji, sub/sup, mark, footnotes, deflist, code highlighting via Shiki)
- **YAML parsing:** `js-yaml`
- **Archiving:** `archiver` (for ZIP generation)
- **Front matter parsing:** `front-matter`
- **Real-time (party):** PartyKit
- **Web app (svelte/redirector):** SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 4 + Vite 5

### 3. What Each Top-Level Package Does

**`cli/tutors-model-lib`** -- The core data model library. Defines all TypeScript types for learning objects (`Lo`, `Course`, `Topic`, `Unit`, `Lab`, `Talk`, `Note`, `Notebook`, `Podcast`, etc.), utility functions for flattening/filtering/decorating the course tree, markdown-to-HTML conversion, and full-text search. Published to JSR as `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`.

**`cli/tutors-gen-lib`** -- The course generation engine. Reads a folder tree from disk, builds a `LearningResource` tree, then constructs a `Course` model from it. Can emit either JSON (for the dynamic Tutors Reader) or static HTML (via Vento templates). Handles file I/O, YAML config reading, Netlify deployment config, and LLM-context file generation. Published to JSR as `@tutors/tutors-gen-lib`.

**`cli/tutors`** -- A thin CLI wrapper. Checks for `course.md` in the current directory, calls `parseCourse()`, `generateDynamicCourse()`, and `copyAssets()` to produce a `json/` folder.

**`cli/tutors-lite`** -- A thin CLI wrapper for static HTML generation. Same pattern but calls `generateStaticCourse()` to produce an `html/` folder.

**`cli/tutors-time-lib`** -- Analytics/time-tracking library using Supabase. Provides models for tracking student time on labs, calendar-based course scheduling, and course analytics. Published to JSR as `@tutors/tutors-time-lib`.

**`cli/tutors-publish-npm`** -- Backward-compatible npm-published CLI. Same as `cli/tutors` but built with `tsc` and published to npm for users not on Deno.

**`party/tutors-party-kit`** -- A PartyKit WebSocket server that broadcasts messages between connected clients. Powers the "live presence" feature in the Tutors Reader where students can see each other's activity.

**`svelte/redirector`** -- A SvelteKit app that redirects any path to `https://tutors.dev` + the same path. Deployed to Netlify so old course URLs redirect to the main Tutors Reader.

### 8. Key Architectural Patterns

**Learning Resource (LR) Tree:** The file system is read into a recursive `LearningResource` tree by `resource-builder.ts`. Each node has a `type` determined by its directory name prefix (e.g., `topic-`, `unit-`, `book-`, `talk-`, `note-`).

**Learning Object (Lo) Model:** The LR tree is converted to a typed `Lo` tree by `course-builder.ts`. The `Lo` type hierarchy: `Lo` (base) -> `Composite` (has `los`, `panels`, `units`) -> `Course` | `Topic` | `Unit` | `Side`. Simple types: `Lab`, `Talk`, `Note`, `Archive`, `Web`, `Github`, `Notebook`, `Podcast`, `Tutorial`, `PanelNote`, `PanelTalk`, `PanelVideo`.

**Two output modes:**
1. **Dynamic (JSON):** Serializes the `Course` Lo to `tutors.json` + generates `netlify.toml` + `index.html` redirect + LLM context files
2. **Static (HTML):** Downloads Vento templates, decorates the course tree with HTML content, emits HTML files per learning object

**Template system:** Vento templates (`.vto` files) generate the static HTML pages with a component-based structure: layouts, navigators, cards, iconography.

### 3. What Each Top-Level Package Does

**`cli/tutors-model-lib`** -- The core data model library. Defines all TypeScript types for learning objects (`Lo`, `Course`, `Topic`, `Unit`, `Lab`, `Talk`, `Note`, `Notebook`, `Podcast`, etc.), utility functions for flattening/filtering/decorating the course tree, markdown-to-HTML conversion, and full-text search. Published to JSR as `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`.

**`cli/tutors-gen-lib`** -- The course generation engine. Reads a folder tree from disk, builds a `LearningResource` tree, then constructs a `Course` model from it. Can emit either JSON (for the dynamic Tutors Reader) or static HTML (via Vento templates). Handles file I/O, YAML config reading, Netlify deployment config, and LLM-context file generation. Published to JSR as `@tutors/tutors-gen-lib`.

**`cli/tutors`** -- A thin CLI wrapper. Checks for `course.md` in the current directory, calls `parseCourse()`, `generateDynamicCourse()`, and `copyAssets()` to produce a `json/` folder.

**`cli/tutors-lite`** -- A thin CLI wrapper for static HTML generation. Same pattern but calls `generateStaticCourse()` to produce an `html/` folder.

**`cli/tutors-time-lib`** -- Analytics/time-tracking library using Supabase. Provides models for tracking student time on labs, calendar-based course scheduling, and course analytics. Published to JSR as `@tutors/tutors-time-lib`.

**`cli/tutors-publish-npm`** -- Backward-compatible npm-published CLI. Same as `cli/tutors` but built with `tsc` and published to npm for users not on Deno.

**`party/tutors-party-kit`** -- A PartyKit WebSocket server that broadcasts messages between connected clients. Powers the "live presence" feature in the Tutors Reader where students can see each other's activity.

**`svelte/redirector`** -- A SvelteKit app that redirects any path to `https://tutors.dev` + the same path. Deployed to Netlify so old course URLs redirect to the main Tutors Reader.

- The `markdown-utils.ts` module (HTML conversion, URL filtering) has zero dedicated tests
- Pure utility functions in `lo-utils.ts`, `course-utils.ts`, `type-utils.ts` have zero dedicated tests

---

### 8. Key Architectural Patterns

**Learning Resource (LR) Tree:** The file system is read into a recursive `LearningResource` tree by `resource-builder.ts`. Each node has a `type` determined by its directory name prefix (e.g., `topic-`, `unit-`, `book-`, `talk-`, `note-`).

**Learning Object (Lo) Model:** The LR tree is converted to a typed `Lo` tree by `course-builder.ts`. The `Lo` type hierarchy: `Lo` (base) -> `Composite` (has `los`, `panels`, `units`) -> `Course` | `Topic` | `Unit` | `Side`. Simple types: `Lab`, `Talk`, `Note`, `Archive`, `Web`, `Github`, `Notebook`, `Podcast`, `Tutorial`, `PanelNote`, `PanelTalk`, `PanelVideo`.

**Two output modes:**
1. **Dynamic (JSON):** Serializes the `Course` Lo to `tutors.json` + generates `netlify.toml` + `index.html` redirect + LLM context files
2. **Static (HTML):** Downloads Vento templates, decorates the course tree with HTML content, emits HTML files per learning object

**Template system:** Vento templates (`.vto` files) generate the static HTML pages with a component-based structure: layouts, navigators, cards, iconography.
